Stop when every capability the proposal lists has its file.

unitemized.reason: "Follow the project's existing organization" is too vague to check. Its checkable part, the flat-layout depth rule, is schema-043 and is recorded as unimplemented.

The rule applies only when there are modified capabilities, and that condition cannot be written as an applies_when predicate (no template label or selector exposes modified capabilities). Per rule 7 it is left unitemized.
Whether a registered standalone store exists cannot be observed from the run, so the condition for allowing or forbidding --store cannot be expressed.

No kind checks a generic '## operation header' format. The ## ADDED Requirements header form is already covered by schema-058's openspec_ff.delta added_only item, and the other openspec.delta rule names are not specified.
